scenarios.name: Hero Section Implementation
scenarios.description: Implement the hero section with product tagline, value proposition, primary CTA, and Three.js background effect

steps.description: Create the HeroSection.tsx component with full-viewport height layout and glassmorphism overlay
steps.context: Component should be placed in src/components/homepage/HeroSection.tsx

steps.description: Import and use the existing BackgroundEffect component for Three.js visual effects
steps.context: BackgroundEffect component already exists in src/components/BackgroundEffect.tsx

steps.action: Add product tagline and value proposition
steps.description: Display 'SHORTEN. TRACK. GROW.' as main heading and value proposition subtitle
steps.context: Use typography classes: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold for heading

steps.description: Add 'Get Started Free' button using FuturisticButton component with navigation to register
steps.context: Button should navigate to /register route

steps.description: Add 'Already have an account? Sign in' text with link to login page
steps.context: Link should navigate to /login route

test_cases.expected: Component renders with full viewport height and visible content
Text 'SHORTEN. TRACK. GROW.' or similar tagline is visible
Subtitle text describing URL shortening with analytics is visible
Button with text 'Get Started' or 'Get Started Free' is visible and clickable
Navigation to /register route is triggered
Text containing 'Sign in' or 'Login' link is visible
Navigation to /login route is triggered
BackgroundEffect component is rendered (canvas element present)

scenarios.name: Features Section Implementation
scenarios.description: Implement the features section displaying 4 key product features in a responsive grid layout

steps.description: Create the FeaturesSection.tsx component with responsive grid layout
steps.context: Component should be placed in src/components/homepage/FeaturesSection.tsx

steps.description: Create grid that shows 1 column on mobile, 2 on tablet, 4 on desktop
steps.context: Use Tailwind classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4

steps.description: Create GlassMorphismCard with link icon, 'URL Shortening' title, and description
steps.context: Description: 'Create short, memorable links'

steps.description: Create GlassMorphismCard with chart icon, 'Click Analytics' title, and description
steps.context: Description: 'Track engagement in real-time'

steps.description: Create GlassMorphismCard with globe icon, 'Geographic Insights' title, and description
steps.context: Description: 'See where your audience is located'

steps.description: Create GlassMorphismCard with share icon, 'Share Stats' title, and description
steps.context: Description: 'Generate public links to share analytics'

test_cases.expected: Component renders with section heading and 4 feature cards
Card with 'URL Shortening' or 'Shorten' text and description is visible
Card with 'Analytics' text and tracking description is visible
Card with 'Geographic' or 'Location' text and description is visible
Card with 'Share' text and public stats description is visible
All feature cards use GlassMorphismCard component styling
Each feature card has an associated icon element
Section has heading text like 'Features' or 'Key Features'

steps.context: Sections should flow naturally with proper spacing

steps.context: All content must be readable without horizontal scrolling

steps.description: Test homepage at 768px width (tablet device)
steps.context: Features grid should show 2 columns

steps.description: Test homepage at 1024px+ width (desktop)
steps.context: Features grid should show 4 columns

steps.description: Ensure buttons and links are appropriately sized for touch on mobile

steps.description: Verify Three.js background performs well or gracefully degrades on mobile
steps.context: Should not cause lag or battery drain

test_cases.expected: All content visible without horizontal scroll, single column layout
Features display in 2-column grid layout
Features display in 4-column grid layout

test_cases.input: Check hero text readability on mobile
test_cases.expected: Hero heading and subheading are readable and properly sized

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Ensure the homepage meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards

steps.description: Verify all interactive elements are accessible via keyboard
steps.context: Tab order should be logical, focus states visible

steps.description: Verify text has sufficient color contrast against backgrounds
steps.context: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text

steps.description: Verify content is accessible to screen readers
steps.context: Use semantic HTML, proper ARIA labels

steps.description: Verify all images and icons have appropriate alt text
steps.context: Decorative images should have empty alt, informative ones should describe content

steps.description: Verify animations respect prefers-reduced-motion setting
steps.context: Users with vestibular disorders should not see animations

test_cases.expected: All interactive elements reachable via Tab key
Focus indicators are clearly visible on all interactive elements

test_cases.input: Test hero text contrast in light theme
test_cases.expected: Text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1)

test_cases.input: Test hero text contrast in dark theme
test_cases.expected: Text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1)
Page uses proper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, etc.)
All buttons have accessible names and roles
All links have descriptive text or aria-labels
Animations are disabled or reduced when preference is set
No critical or serious accessibility violations
